summary.text: Jennifer Moore, the Republican and Conservative Party nominee for New York's 10th Congressional District, lost the November 3, 2026 election to Brad Lander, receiving 15.9% of the vote to Lander's 83.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
She advanced after both June 23, 2026 primaries were canceled, and the New York Post describes her as a Brooklyn Republican Party operative.
She said she ran to give voters a choice after Brad Lander defeated incumbent Rep. Daniel Goldman in the Democratic primary.
